svg.title: From minutes to hours
svg.desc: 22 METR TH1.1 historical 50%-success time-horizon estimates, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Logarithmic human-task-duration axis; release dates March 2023 to March 2026. GPT-4 about 4 minutes, Claude 3.7 Sonnet about 1 hour, Claude Opus 4.6 about 12 hours. Above-16-hour Mythos point omitted; full source data retained. Source: https://metr.org/assets/benchmark_results_1_1.yaml

g.title: claude_3_opus_inspect; release 2024-03-04; p50 3.952262 min; 95% CI 1.706313–8.76484 min

svg.text: 22 estimates below 16 h; not a complete frontier.
Mythos Preview (early) above range: not plotted.
No forecast. Dates are releases, not evaluations.
